/--
Match pattern for the `done` case. See also `IterStep.done`.
-/
@[match_pattern, simp, expose]
def PlausibleIterStep.done {IsPlausibleStep : IterStep α β → Prop}
    (h : IsPlausibleStep .done) : PlausibleIterStep IsPlausibleStep :=
  ⟨.done, h⟩
